scenario.title: Uninstall and removing the operating layer
situations: Stop using Yoke on one machine.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Verify preservation/cleanup across modified managed files and later-installed harnesses; machine-wide light hooks and the global skill have no removal yet.

lessons.title: Choose data and project removal separately
lessons.need: Local/self-host data may be the only copy. Backup choice and which project layers to remove are distinct; there is no automatic backup. Explicit unattended choices are required.
lessons.surface: Install -> Uninstall -> command help and first prompts.

lessons.title: Recover leftovers without deleting unknown files
lessons.when: Uninstall or reinstall reports stale foreign-install state or partial failure
lessons.need: Setup offers Unlink and set up fresh when a checkout links to a project the chosen install lacks or the account cannot access. Project uninstall still removes the layer when the owning install is gone and warns that the commit belongs on the default branch. Machine uninstall skips Docker without a self-host install, strips Yoke's Cursor user hooks, and reverts only the harness settings it recorded writing while they still hold Yoke's value; changed settings are reported and kept, and a failed revert keeps the machine home for a retry.
lessons.surface: Setup project step stale-link view; uninstall step results and warnings.
